verdict.rationale: Gusto's Embedded Payroll docs show a full time-off request lifecycle—balance checking, submission, admin approval, and payroll integration—plus a way for partners to record approved time off without rebuilding the approval workflow (gusto-docs-11, gusto-docs-12, gusto-docs-19, gusto-docs-29, gusto-docs-33). However, there's no explicit documentation of an ops user defining/configuring accrual *policies* (accrual rates, tiers, carryover rules) — the docs mention checking balances but not policy authoring UI/API. Missing for 10: accrual policy configuration details, evidence of automatic accrual-rate setup, and independent/hands-on confirmation that PTO approvals flow automatically into payroll runs without manual reconciliation.
